notes: NEW subject pack: Literature Basics — close reading, theme, plot and structure, character, imagery and figurative language, symbolism, point of view and narrator, and tone and mood, with which-idea, figurative-device, rhyme-scheme, and stanza line-count practice, never your assignment.

Detector V35 was trained and measured this run but HELD, not shipped: on the permanent frozen probe it caught 11 of 18 humanized texts, below the shipped V20’s 13, so V20 stays live until a round genuinely beats it. The round’s new 23 stylometric features (sentence rhythm, word length, lexical diversity, pronoun and punctuation rates) separate train-style humanized text well but push the held-out blogger style toward human; main accuracy reached 86.8% (best yet), neural-paraphrase detection improved to 56.5%, and the false-flag rate stayed below V20’s at 4.63%.
